paragraphs: System Innovators sells inovah, revenue management and cashiering software that consolidates payment channels and revenue streams across a government enterprise. The homepage presents the product as a central place to manage payments and receivable systems, and as a hub for revenue activity that reduces reconciliation hours and manual general ledger updates. Integration options on the homepage run from real-time interfaces to file imports and main-frame integration.

The homepage states that the company serves solely in the public sector and offers city, county and state level solutions. Client success stories on that page name the City of Sacramento, the City of Seattle and Dakota County.

The about page dates the company to 1980 and describes early utility billing systems with over-the-counter cashiering. In 2008 the company became part of N. Harris Computer, adding to a public sector solutions portfolio. The same page says inovah continues as one of the first POS applications to receive the new PCI-SSF certification.
